cues.text: We hear the song of D-Rock beneath the ever-turning sky
We carry a self-made answer through the patient night and home
The quiet horizon turns until the room remembers
We hear D-Rock where the ever-turning horizon meets the dark beyond us

We hear D-Rock where the ever-turning horizon meets the dark
And every self-made answer turns slowly toward the room
My mother‐in‐law remembers all the names we carried
Through the silence and the last remaining light
A quiet orbit fades beyond the cobalt tide
We carry every answer home beneath the turning sky
The signal returns to the room where we began
And nothing of the words we sang is lost
